long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Riga, Vitali Kivmann studied at the Technical University of Berlin before completing training in economics, business and corporate finance. He went on to advise international commodity-trading companies, then developed a portfolio career in structured financing for multinational businesses and property investment.

Work on an innovation hub in Potsdam became an important link between those fields. The project led to a successful investment partnership and contributed to Raw Ventures' formation. Kivmann's approach there centres on assessing the people behind a startup, including their judgement, adaptability and ability to meet unforeseen challenges. It weighs those qualities alongside the originality of an idea and its prospective profit.
